headline: Web Designer
summary: Web designer with four years designing websites and landing pages for resorts, coffee brands and schools in Batangas. I design in Figma, prepare images in Photoshop, and build the pages myself in WordPress or hand-coded HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I sit comfortably between design and front-end work.

certifications.name: Adobe Certified Professional: Visual Design using Photoshop

skills: UI design for websites and landing pages
Graphic design for web banners and brand assets

experience.title: Web Designer
bullets: Design and build about 20 websites a year for resorts, coffee farms and private schools.
Create clickable Figma prototypes and test them with clients before development.
Build pages in WordPress and custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including booking forms and galleries.
Prepare web images and banners in Photoshop for fast loading.

experience.title: Graphic and Web Design Associate
bullets: Designed social media graphics, brochures and website mock-ups for clients.
Updated client WordPress sites with new content and layouts.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, major in Web and Multimedia
